text:
deploybot: Deploy paused: keystore metadata epoch mismatch detected between staging and prod. Blocker: keystore.metadata.epoch != expected. Holding release in release-window (10:00-11:00 UTC).

alice.dev: saw this too when running the postdeploy sanity check locally. staging epoch 1688790000 vs prod 1688793600.

sanjay.m: likely because the keystore backfill job ran at a different time and stamped a new epoch in prod. staging didn't get the latest copy.

ops-oncall: deploybot logs: `validation failed: keystore epoch mismatch` -> prevents key-rotation step.

carla: is this just metadata or an actual key material difference?

alice.dev: metadata only — the key blobs are identical AFAICT. it's the `metadata.epoch` field used by the deploy checks.

release-coordinator: we have two options: 1) quick backfill to staging (copy prod metadata epoch -> staging) and resume, or 2) abort and rollback the staging changes that expected the new epoch. which is safer for the window?

ops-oncall: backfill is less disruptive but needs approved write to staging keystore. can do a controlled copy with audit log entries.

carla: agree. low risk. we should snapshot current staging keystore first: `aws s3 cp s3://keystore/staging/keystore.json /tmp/keystore.staging.snapshot.json` then patch.

alice.dev: proposed patch (one-liner):
```
aws s3 cp s3://keystore/prod/keystore.json - | jq '.metadata.epoch = 1688793600' > /tmp/keystore.staging.json && aws s3 cp /tmp/keystore.staging.json s3://keystore/staging/keystore.json --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```

deploybot: NOTE: deploybot will re-run validations after the keystore update. Do not resume the rollout until validations green.

sanjay.m: I'll run the snapshot + patch now (will run from bastion, log kept). ping once complete.

ops-oncall: FYI tagging: @security and @compliance will get the S3 write event; leave a brief note in the release notes about manual keystore parity fix.

release-coordinator: decision: proceed with controlled backfill. pin model variant for this rollout to `prod-model@v2026-03-21` to avoid any additional model variant churn during the window.

carla: adding temporary release note entry: "Manual keystore metadata parity backfill applied to staging at 10:07 UTC to satisfy deploy-time validation. No key material changed."

sanjay.m: backfill done, pushed snapshot to /tmp and uploaded patched file. command exit 0. logs: s3://keystore/audit/1767007777-keystore-backfill.log

deploybot: Re-running preflight checks...

deploybot: Preflight checks passed. Resuming rollout.

alice.dev: great — canary is still first 10% as planned. watching metrics. :eyes:

ops-oncall: keep alerting on key-rotation jobs for next 2 hours. I'll stay on watch.

release-coordinator: leaving note: will include this incident in post-release notes and add a small issue to ensure keystore backfill job runs to both environments in a single transaction (or add epoch reconciliation). Creating issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4521

carla: +1. postmortem unnecessary but add checklist item for future release windows.

sanjay.m: one followup: propose deploybot tolerance change — allow +-300s epoch skew for metadata-only diffs. I'll open a PR with tests.

release-coordinator: thanks all. marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
